item.title: Meta MTIA 300
item.description: Meta detailed the MTIA 300 on August 24, 2026, its first MTIA chip aimed at large training workloads rather than just inference. It pairs a 12x6 grid of processing elements with 216GB of HBM3E and two network chiplets carrying twelve custom 800 Gbps RDMA NICs, giving each chip 1.2 TB/s of I/O bandwidth so training jobs can scale across racks without relying on separate networking hardware.

item.title: Marketinguys
item.description:
Marketinguys works as a directory of marketing talent. Businesses looking for a freelancer or agency can browse profiles, compare specialties such as SEO, social media, or branding, and reach out to candidates.

Directories like this save time in the first round of research, though quality varies and vetting is the buyer’s job. Check portfolios, references, and contracts before hiring.

Independent information is limited. The platform is free to browse. Alternatives include Clutch, Upwork, Fiverr, DesignRush, and Sortlist. Marketinguys suits businesses looking for marketing help.
